design.coefficients: all one; original integer component deltas; single clip
design.eligibility: Only evaluate when independently audited weighted gate passes against v79 AND equal-variance. Three-TabM requires both predeclared audited three-versus-one improvements, otherwise one-TabM. Stand requires both standalone gates AND its fixed selected-NN/runway combination gate.
design.primary: weighted addition versus identical selected NN/runway/optional-stand combination rooted at v79
design.control: exact existing selected combination replay; no outcome-selected weights or thresholds
design.caveat: Reused development data; weighted leaderboard loss unknown
